comment: Production sources the probe compiles, VERBATIM (byte-identical copies staged at run time; SHA256 of every staged file is recorded in results.json). The target name FLFitProduction exists only inside the probe package; the files themselves are untouched app sources.

files.role: domain: health profile used by scoring
domain: cooking history referenced by services
production composition policy (fallback IDs, near-match limits, widening)
schema: the same migrations the app runs
THE FIT QUERY: findMakeable / findNearMatch (ID-membership matching)
scoring surfaces: ScoredRecipe, ranking reasons, 'Complete match' text

vendored.role: the exact GRDB the app vendors

replicated_boundary.meaning: Production derives the fit's availableIds from inventory lots ONLY (remaining_grams > 0); pantry assumptions never join the recommendation fit. The probe inputs apply the same mapping; the line itself is app-composition (SwiftUI host) and cannot compile on Linux.
The fit text production renders on every scored card; the probe's rows are the inputs to that string, reconstructed in the audit.
